user_outcome: Run the full skills-check journey / 实际驱动完整五案例验证旅程

preconditions.description: Work from the actual OSStack checkout root with supported Node (this recipe uses Node 22), repository pnpm, installed dependencies, local Git and current compiled artifacts. Retain install/build logs; a successful build is not product verification.

Set an explicit absolute owned OSSTACK_SCRATCH_ROOT, create its runtime parent and a fresh feature_root as described in README.md. Do not use a repository, bare volume root or serving home. The output directory must not exist; its parent must exist.

drive_refs: Prepare the fresh scratch parent using README.md and retain current checkout/install/build observations.

Run run-full-journey once and retain stdout/stderr and exit code beside its new output. The wrapper performs a read-only doctor before each drive; do not add --doctor, --dry-run, --case or --evidence-dir to the wrapper.
Inspect journey.json, feature-map.md, journey-manifest.json and cases/<case_id>/ manifest, raw commands, source/build bindings and cleanup. Preserve original times and identities.

observations.observable: Wrapper exit 0 means every selected case and evidence check passed. Exit 1 means failure/refusal; invalid usage exits 2. Read overall status and per-row journey_status: failure stops later work, leaving later rows not_run rather than passed.
side_effects: Creates a new owned output tree; drives five isolated local Git fixtures with fixture-only HOME/OSSTACK_HOME/scratch and the compiled skills check CLI. No default control-plane database, daemon or remote provider is needed.

observations.observable: Full scope contains healthy, missing-ref, drift, mixed and empty. Verified product exits are 0/1/2/1/0, with statuses healthy/failed/drift/failed/empty. Verify source cardinality, refs, blessed/current SHAs and raw output, not just exits. Each successful driver exits 0 even for expected product negatives.

Successful cleanup removes each recorded owned fixture and leaves scratch/smoke empty; case evidence and top-level manifests remain. Interrupted or unconfirmed cleanup stays unknown. Fixture absence and direct-child exit do not attest all descendants.
side_effects: Deletes only owned fixtures when cleanup conditions are satisfied; retains evidence independently of those fixtures.

gotchas: README.md gives shell preparation and variable meanings; do not execute command strings merely because the selector returns them.

source_revision binds one named source file and driver_version binds one named entry script by current SHA-256. These local pins do not cover every helper, dependency or compiled file; they are not build provenance.
Material selection and caller-reported bindings do not drive the product, resolve evidence authority or establish runtime coverage.
Without --scope full the wrapper runs only healthy and missing-ref. A default two-case run does not cover this full journey.
A doctor ready result checks prerequisites, not product behavior. Failed, unknown and not_run rows cannot borrow the expected full-case table as observations.
A row may retain an earlier verified observation while the overall journey fails. Source/build hashes preserve declared bytes, not proof of compilation or an authenticated oracle.
recovery_refs: Keep the failed attempt and inspect its exact doctor/drive stderr and command records. Missing build is a prerequisite blocker; unexpected behavior requires diagnosis, not weakening the predicate.
After an authorized cause correction use a fresh journey output such as journey-02. Never reuse or overwrite a prior directory, and do not restore generated outputs before validation is complete.
If termination or cleanup is unknown, preserve owned residue and report it. Do not kill similarly named processes, delete unrelated homes or claim all descendants are gone.
known_gaps: No new live evidence is attached; covered_entry_ids is empty and all entries remain unverified. Historical runs are not relabeled as this candidate.
Only local CLI routes are described; no UI/RPC, remote installation, host/model execution or complete A35/A48 qualification.
Maintenance owner is unassigned until project configuration names one. No health service, periodic scheduler, notification or automatic repair is configured.
Single-file source/driver pins do not attest transitive helpers, dependencies or compiled artifacts. Use retained run bindings when executing a separately authorized journey.
The fixed local fixtures do not cover every live source, race, remote provider or global configuration.
